name: MTAC 375 402 MAX (MTAC, 402 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".913 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".458 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .375, Grains 402, Minimum Required Twist *1-9", Part Number MTAC 375 402 MAX, G1 BC .913 (A.B.), G7 BC .458 (A.B.), OAL 2.209", Bullet Projection 1.609"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.609".
